g1_male_momayez_item1: A male pilgrim must be circumcised.
g1_male_momayez_item2: It is recommended to refrain from cutting the hair of the head and beard for one month before entering Ihram.
g1_general_item1: It is discouraged to apply henna before Ihram if its colour will remain at the time of entering Ihram.<bullet>Make a will.
g1_female_item1: She may take medication to delay menstruation after consulting a doctor.
g2_male_item1: Two white, unstitched Ihram cloths: an Izar and a Rida
g3_general_item1:
Taqlid:
If you do not follow a Marja, you must choose one before travelling, according to the principles explained in books of Islamic jurisprudence.
g3_general_item2:
Correct Recitation of Prayer and Talbiyah:
You must learn the correct recitation of the prayer and Talbiyah before travelling.
g3_general_item3: Learn the practical rulings of Wudu, Ghusl, and prayer.
g3_general_item4: Learn the rulings concerning the purity of the body and clothing.
g3_general_item5: Learn the rulings of Umrah according to the fatwas of your Marja.
outside_mighat: I am travelling from outside the Miqat boundaries (for example, from Pakistan).
mecca_mighat: My home is located between Makkah and the Miqat.
ihram_selector_title: You may enter Ihram at one of the following places. Please select one:
before_mighat: Before the Miqat by making a vow or due to fear of missing Umrah in Rajab
boundary_mighat: At a point parallel to the Miqat
mighat_guide_item1: The Miqat for the people of Madinah and those travelling through that route is Dhul-Hulayfah (Masjid al-Shajarah).
mighat_guide_item2: The Miqat for the people of Syria, Egypt, North Africa, and those travelling through that route is Al-Juhfah.
mighat_guide_item3: The Miqat for the people of Taif and those travelling through that route is Qarn al-Manazil (Al-Sayl al-Kabir).
mighat_guide_item4: The Miqat for the people of Yemen and those travelling through that route is Yalamlam.
mighat_guide_item5: The Miqat for the people of Iraq, Najd, and those travelling through that route is Dhat Irq.
pretravil_p7_text: Wait until you reach the Miqat and enter Ihram there.
mecca_mighat_text: Your Miqat is Adna al-Hill, such as Hudaybiyah, Ji‘ranah, or Tan‘im (Masjid Aishah). These three places have no special distinction; rather, it is sufficient to enter Ihram from any place outside the boundaries of the Haram of Makkah.
jeddah_mighat_text: You may enter Ihram for Hajj or Umrah from Jeddah itself without making a vow, and you do not need to travel to any Miqat.
between_mecca_mighat_text: You may enter Ihram from your home and do not need to return to any Miqat.
before_mighat_title: You may enter Ihram before the Miqat only in the following two cases:
fom_rajab: Fear of Missing Umrah in Rajab
vow_warning_title: Important Note Before Making a Vow:
vow_warning_text: If you are certain that, after entering Ihram by a vow, you will travel under shade or in the rain, the vow will not take effect, based on obligatory precaution.
solution_item1: Arrange your journey so that this problem does not arise.
solution_item2: Refer to the next most learned Marja and act according to their fatwa.
fomo_text: If you fear that waiting until you reach the Miqat will prevent you from entering Ihram during the month of Rajab, you may enter Ihram during Rajab from any place before the Miqat without making a vow.
nadhr_description: The formula must be recited verbally and may be recited in either of the following two ways:
without_place_box_text:
Based on this formula, you may enter Ihram from any place you choose before the Miqat or at a point parallel to the Miqat.
Formula:
لِلّٰهِ عَلَيَّ أَنْ أُحْرِمَ قَبْلَ الْمِيقَاتِ
Translation:
For the sake of Allah, it is incumbent upon me to enter Ihram before the Miqat.
with_place_box_text:
The specified place must be before the Miqat or at a point parallel to the Miqat.
Formula:
لِلّٰهِ عَلَيَّ أَنْ أُحْرِمَ مِنْ --- (for example: Qom) 
Translation:
For the sake of Allah, it is incumbent upon me to enter Ihram from --- (for example: Qom).
nadr_notice_text:
Making a vow does not itself put you in the state of Ihram.
Wait until you reach the place specified in your vow, and enter Ihram from there.
pretravil_notice_default: You may attend Tibyan Academy’s classes to learn the above-mentioned rulings.
